messages:
rachel: Kicking off telemetry stack provisioning for the new GPU pool in eu-west-3. Scope: Loki (logs), Prometheus (metrics), Tempo (traces), Grafana dashboards, and Alertmanager rule set.

rachel: Hand-off plan — I need a 2hr oncall doubler to watch smoke and validate dashboards. Plan attached below.

dan: quick q — per-region Loki or central? egress costs are a concern.

rachel: per-region Loki with forwarding to central S3 cold-tier. Lower query latency for local alerts and cheaper cross-region storage.

siva: Terraform PR opened with network and security groups for telemetry nodes, pinged @rachel for review.

rachel: got it, posting the small smoke checks we'll run:

rachel: ```
# push a fake GPU agent log
curl -X POST http://loki.eu-west-3.internal:3100/loki/api/v1/push \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"streams":[{"stream":{"job":"gpu-agent-smoke"},"values":[["$(date +%s)000000000","gpu=0 temp=72 usage=12"]]}]}'
```

jen: For Grafana, clone dashboards/gpu/pod_gpu_util.json then change datasource to prom-eu-west-3 and update prometheus query window to 6h.

dan: ran prometheus target check — node-exporter 3/3, cadvisor 3/3, kube-state 1/1. All targets up.

siva: prometheus scrape config snippet I used:

siva: ```yaml
- job_name: 'gpu-nodes'
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
    - role: node
  relabel_configs:
    - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_node_label_gpu]
      regex: true
      action: keep
  metric_relabel_configs:
    - regex: "(node_filefd_unused)"
      action: drop
```

rachel: good. Alert templates to add to Alertmanager (high-level): GPUUtilHigh, NVMLTempCritical, LokiIngestLag. Example rule:

rachel: ```yaml
- alert: GPUUtilHigh
  expr: avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_utilization[5m]) > 85
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "GPU utilization >85% on {{ $labels.instance }}"
    runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-saturation"
```

ops-natalie: note on cost — Loki ingesters will spike with verbose kernel logs. Recommend enabling sampling for dmesg/kern logs and compressing ingesters to 1d retention before archiving. Estimated incremental cost: "~$28/day" for this pool at current traffic.

leo: added sampling flag to the helmvalues and bumped loki replicas to 3 for ingestion resilience.

rachel: handoff: @jen is oncall for the next 2 hours to watch the dashboards and escalations. Handoff checklist:
- confirm logs flowing to Loki
- confirm Prometheus targets healthy
- verify Grafana panels show metrics for last 30m
- ensure alerts fire on synthetic conditions

jen: oncall ack :thumbsup: watching now.

infra-bot: telemetry-loki-eu-west-3 deployment started by siva (deploy-1234).

deploy-bot: smoke tests: logs accepted, prom targets ok, grafana provisioning complete.

rachel: thanks — please create a JIRA to track remaining todos (dashboard tidy, cost tuning, archive policy).

dan: INFRA-4572 created and assigned to rachel.

rachel: closing the provisioning thread once JIRA has verification check. Great work team :tada:
